It was re-captured as UTF-8 (BOM) by re-running the SAME bound argv, so the stdout.txt in evidence/ is the definitive run's output in the same encoding as the rest of the evidence set.
stdout_reencoding.proof: the re-run produced a byte-identical run_result.json (recovery/rerun_check/rerun_check.json: byte_identical = true) and the printed values in stdout.txt match the evidence files (printed_value_checks all true)
